meta.note: Evidence 'vN fA-B' = video N frames A-B @30fps. v1/v4 are 25fps captures (±40 ms). Motion for React takes seconds: divide ms by 1000. Easing arrays are cubic-bezier [x1,y1,x2,y2].
meta.ip: Motion feel only; all art original; no reference names, brands or licensed mascot.
meta.amendments: 1.1.0: adds audit.md adopted values (overshootTiers, flowerCurtain, flash, scrim, typewriter floor, prompt trigger, booth cadences, chrome mount, hint ladder); fixes the finale wall unit (vh = 1% of viewport height); product booth digits now 200/1200/2200 ms (ux.md §5.4). See docs/FRAMEWORK.md §4. | 1.2.0: spring fields renamed overshootPctOfTravel + fromValue/peakFinal/tier (ceiling checked on peakFinal only); choreographies are typed Spec objects keyed C1-C13 (steps {name, at, dur, target, action, params, ease|spring, tierMin}); a step on spring.X lasts spring.X.settleMs; hint ring x1.8; micro-hold 67-233 ms; drawer is a 560 ms tween (audit 1.4); capture-pixel values converted to relative units; bloom 870+2500 ms, edges 3370+760 ms; P44-P48 added; product booth first flash 3400 ms; camera preview 4:3; tier promotion to high.
meta.units: Distances are relative: vw / vh (CSS, 1% of the viewport), % of the moving object's own size (W/H), or 'stage px' in the 390x844 stage box (FRAMEWORK §5.7). A value tagged '@1024 capture' is the raw reference measurement; scale it by (stage width / 1024) before use, never paste it as CSS px.

product.evidence: ux.md §5.4; audit 1.9 (first shot ~200 ms after '1' exits), 1.10
product.timerRule: every digit lasts digitMs (1000); only the last 3 are stampPop, earlier digits hard-cut as small numerals; firstFlashMs = 200 + 1000*n + 200 (n = timer seconds)
product.printNote: measured 95-162 px/s on a ~110 px mini strip @1024 capture = 0.86-1.47 mini-strip heights/s; adopted 0.9 (audit 1.10)

giftBooth.flashScope: booth window only (<25% of viewport); any full-screen flash keeps >=1000 ms spacing
giftBooth.note: no camera: the sender's photos reveal one per flash

tiers.noDeviceMemory: Safari/iOS and Firefox expose no deviceMemory: start at mid explicitly (do not read undefined as 4). Verify what iOS Safari reports for hardwareConcurrency in M0 (it may be clamped)
tiers.probe: 30 rAF deltas during the landing idle: p90 > 20 ms drops one tier; 60 deltas with p90 < 12 ms promotes mid -> high

cameraPreview.aspect: 4:3 everywhere (3:4 preview, 4:3 strip cells crop from a 4:3 source)

renderer.canvas: particles, flower curtains, bloom, finale; atlas WebP <=2048^2 via createImageBitmap

reducedMotion.idleWobble: off (static pose, 2 px static outline as the hint)
reducedMotion.risingParallax: static layout, items fade in 200 ms in place
reducedMotion.tokenDrop: coin hard-cuts to the heart in the slot (no travel)

overshootTiers.unit: peak value in final-size units (what the eye sees), not % of travel. Checked against spring.*.peakFinal (generated), never overshootPctOfTravel

t0.use: fades, drawers, docks, scrims, crossfades, camera moves, lid flip, layout moves
t0.evidence: v2b; v3 M-rows; v4 B7, C9; v1 #37; v5 B-08

overshootTiers.overshootAllowed: derived from tier: t0 = false; t1-t3 and ambient = true

flowerCurtain.unit: CSS vh (1% of viewport height). 1 viewport-height/s = 100 vh/s
flowerCurtain.seed: mulberry32(hash(giftId)); every sprite is a pure function f(index, t, seed)

bloom.law: radial emitter, coverage bloomCoverage over 2500 ms (f58-133 relative to tap f32: 870 -> 3370 ms)
bloom.evidence: v5 A-e08 f57-156 (edges stop top f139, right f150, left f156); A-m02 last wave 333 ms f147-156

flowerCurtain.rule: leaving sprites accelerate (gravity / ease-in); sweeping sprites move at constant speed; no flower decelerates into an exit

screenFill.note: functional front-camera fill; calibrate per device (rise->first lit rVFC frame)

flash.zOrder: below hero/celebration sprites and below chrome
flash.photosensitivity: WCAG 2.3.1: never more than 3 full-screen flashes per second; v1 reference cadence (240 ms) is an anti-pattern (audit A1)

scrim.rules: never blur, never neutral black; drawers have no scrim
scrim.auditDivergence: audit 1.5 proposes 280 ms ease for both; tokens keep the measured 300 ms standard (letter, v1 #39) and 267 ms linear (photo, v4 D5). FRAMEWORK §10.2 erratum 19

prompt.trigger: Director run.finished of the preceding spectacle (never a fixed timer)
prompt.evidence: v5 A-e10 f152-158 vs last edge settle f156 (audit A8)

hintLadder.evidence: +1.2 s is a design choice (ux.md §1.2). v4 ring #1 starts at f68 (A7), overlapping the curtain end (f71); rings #2 and #3 follow at +0.87 s (f97) and +1.37 s (~f112) after f71

idle.interactive: <=1 hint loop on the tap target + <=1 slow ambient prop (<=±1-3°, period >=800 ms)

idleWobble.raw: x -8..+8 px, y 0..+12 px @576-wide capture on a ~212x173 px card
idleWobble.g3Exemption: the tap target's hint loop may exceed ±3°
